verification.rule: Preserve claims as source claims. Never promote them to ArcSweep fact without separate evidence.

patterns.summary: Present ordinary instrumentation as an intentional field practice while keeping the raw measurement available underneath the narrative layer.
Reveal an experience in deliberate phases instead of loading every control at once.
Give each participant a persistent session identity and record without copying a centralised surveillance model.
For paired observation experiments, seal both parties' observations before either sees the counterpart result, then reveal together.
Treat distributed participants as voluntary nodes contributing permissioned observations to a shared map or event window.
Scheduled events can alter the artefact state and create synchronous participation without turning the interface into a notification machine.
Store what the instrument measured and what a participant inferred as separate fields joined by provenance rather than collapsing them into one claim.
Use low-amplitude idle motion and reserve larger effects for actual state changes.
Let marks appear to have been present in the material all along, becoming legible only when interaction or state reaches the right condition.

explicit_nonimports: claims about a historic monitoring network
participant data model that centralises private practice by default
full-screen HUD treatment that obscures the book
